fact: Part III of Tanzania's Finance Act, 2026 (published 30 June 2026) amends section 13 of the existing Electronic Transactions Act (Cap. 442), so that Act is in force; the document gives no date for the event beyond its own publication date.
The report cites the Electronic Transactions Act (2022) among the laws in place.
The Ministry says the government enacted the Electronic Transaction Act, 2015 under the RCIP project.
